AOMEI update configuration redirected clients to malicious archives

Target: AOMEI Technology
Date: 2026-05-28 to 2026-07-20 (53 days)
Actor: UNC7017 (group)
Target Kind: update_service
Language: N/A
Impact: backdoor
Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers briefly modified AOMEI update and notification settings, then restored them. Clients polling during the observed windows downloaded and executed payloads leading to the CROSSROAD downloader and SHINYROAD backdoor.
